Systematizing doctrinal categories according to the matrix of Abhidhamma phenomena, the section provides an exposition (*niddesa*) of states that are included and unincluded by way of what is dissociated (*vippayuttena saṅgahitāsaṅgahita*) [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral records one translation in a modern language for this text [SuttaCentral].
